'''Reinier Wilhelmus "Rein" Welschen''' (29 August 1941 – 17 September 2013) was a Dutch [[politician]] and member of the [[Labour Party (Netherlands)|Labour Party]] (PvdA).

Welschen served as an [[wethouder|alderman]] of [[Breda]] from 1978 to 1987. He was a [[Provincial-Executive (Netherlands)|Provincial-Executive]] of [[North Brabant]] from 1987 to 1992. He served as the [[Mayor]] of [[Eindhoven]] from 1992 until 2003.<ref name=enews>{{cite news|title=Ex mayor Welschen passed away |url=http://www.eindhovennews.nl/news/20339-ex-mayor-welschen-passed-away.html |work=[[Eindhoven News]] |date=2013-09-18|access-date=2013-10-03}}</ref> The city experienced the bankruptcy of both the [[DAF Cars]] and the Operation Centurion at Philips during his tenure, which increased unemployment.<ref name=enews/> A major crash of a [[Belgian Air Force]] [[C-130 Hercules]] also took place on 15 July 1996.<ref name=enews/> In 2004 he was acting mayor of [[Westland (municipality), Netherlands|Westland]].

Rein Welschen had been in declining health for several years.<ref name=enews/> He died on 17 September 2013, at the age of 72.<ref name=enews/> His funeral was held in [[Breda]], while a memorial service was held Eindhoven's city hall on 27 September 2013.<ref name=enews/>
